news.text: Anna started the career, 2016 to 2017.
The 2016 season begins. Anna drives for Ferrari (#7). Ben drives for Ferrari (#8).
Anna's rival this season: Felipe Massa (Williams). Ben's rival this season: Felipe Massa (Williams).

From the Australian Grand Prix, Max Verstappen drives for Toro Rosso in place of Daniil Kvyat for a while. Anna against team-mate Ben: qualifying 9:12, races 14:7. Anna won the rivalry with Felipe Massa 11:10. Ben against team-mate Anna: qualifying 12:9, races 7:14. Ben lost the rivalry with Felipe Massa 10:11.

Contracts for 2017: Anna has offers from Ferrari (2 years, $6.65M a season), McLaren (1 year, $4.5M a season), Toro Rosso (2 years, $4.05M a season), Haas (3 years, $3.7M a season). Ben has offers from Ferrari (1 year, $4.3M a season), Haas (1 year, $2.2M a season), Sauber (2 years, $1.95M a season).
